subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

By hook or by crook
solution:
The correct answer is **By any means.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• ** **The most appropriate meaning of the idiom By hook or by crook is By any means.​​

 
 
• **Example: **Ramesh will have to complete my assignment today **by hook and by a cook.**
 
 
 
• **​**Thus the correct meaning of the given idiom is By any means.

44:T
